name: Perspectives  Special Ed
description: Comprehensive syllabus covering philosophical foundations, educational agencies, historical models, policy frameworks, and instructional strategies for Special and Inclusive Education in the DSC examination.

topics.name: Philosophical Foundations of Education
topics.description: Study of major educational philosophies, western and Indian philosophical thinkers, and pioneers in special education.

subtopics.name: Meaning and Schools of Philosophy
subtopics.description: Fundamental concepts of educational philosophy and major western educational philosophies.

concepts.name: Educational Philosophy & Practice
concepts.description: Definition of educational philosophy and its foundational relationship with educational practices and classroom strategies.
concepts.learning_objective: Understand the meaning of educational philosophy and explain how philosophy guides practical educational decision-making.

concepts.name: Idealism and Naturalism
concepts.description: Core principles of Idealism and Naturalism and their implications for education.
concepts.learning_objective: Differentiate between Idealist and Naturalist approaches to curriculum, teacher roles, and student learning.

concepts.name: Pragmatism and Humanism
concepts.description: Key beliefs of Pragmatism and Humanism in shaping child-centric and experiential learning.
concepts.learning_objective: Analyze the impact of pragmatism and humanistic values in special and general education settings.

subtopics.name: Prominent Western and Indian Philosophers
subtopics.description: Educational thoughts and principles of key thinkers in Western and Indian contexts.

concepts.name: Western Thinkers: Dewey, Kilpatrick, and Rousseau
concepts.description: Contributions of John Dewey (Progressivism), William Kilpatrick (Project Method), and Jean-Jacques Rousseau (Naturalism).
concepts.learning_objective: Identify the key pedagogical contributions of Dewey, Kilpatrick, and Rousseau.

concepts.name: Indian Educational Philosophers
concepts.description: Educational vision and principles of Mahatma Gandhi (Nai Talim), Sri Aurobindo (Integral Education), Rabindranath Tagore (Vishva Bharati), and Swami Vivekananda (Man-making education).
concepts.learning_objective: Explain the educational philosophies of prominent Indian thinkers and their relevance to holistic learning.

concepts.name: Pioneers in Special Education
concepts.description: Contributions of pioneers like Jean-Marc-Gaspard Itard and Helen Keller to special education methodology.
concepts.learning_objective: Examine the early historical breakthroughs and methods established by pioneers like Itard and Helen Keller.

topics.name: Agencies, Modes, and Contexts of Education
topics.description: Types of educational agencies, learning modes, diverse school contexts, and institutional governance.

subtopics.name: Agencies and Modes of Education
subtopics.description: Formal, informal, and non-formal agencies alongside regular, open, distance, and blended delivery modes.

concepts.name: Formal, Informal, and Non-Formal Agencies
concepts.description: Characteristics and structures of formal, informal, and non-formal agencies of education.
concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish between formal, informal, and non-formal educational settings and their roles in learning.

concepts.name: Modes of Educational Delivery
concepts.description: Regular classroom education, open schooling, distance and online education, and blended learning models.
concepts.learning_objective: Compare different modes of learning and evaluate their application for learners with diverse needs.

subtopics.name: Schooling Contexts and Educational Organizations
subtopics.description: Types of schools, home-based education, family/community roles, and institutional support bodies.

concepts.name: Types of Schools and Learning Settings
concepts.description: Comparison of regular schools, inclusive schools, special schools, and home-based educational programs.
concepts.learning_objective: Differentiate between regular, inclusive, special, and home-based learning contexts for children with special needs.

concepts.name: Community, Family, and Mass Media
concepts.description: The influence and role of family, local community, and mass media as educational agencies.
concepts.learning_objective: Describe how family, mass media, and community networks support non-formal and inclusive education.

concepts.name: Role of Governmental Organizations
concepts.description: Roles and functions of NCERT, SCERT, NCTE, UGC, and the Ministry of Education in policy formulation and quality control.
concepts.learning_objective: Identify the primary administrative and professional functions of national and state educational organizations.

concepts.name: Role of National and International NGOs
concepts.description: Contribution of non-governmental organizations in promoting inclusive education and disability rights.
concepts.learning_objective: Assess the impact of national and international NGOs in supporting education for children with disabilities.

topics.name: Perspectives in Special Education - Ancient to Contemporary
topics.description: Historical evolution, disability models, paradigm shifts, inclusive practices, and universal designs for instruction.

subtopics.name: History, Diversity, and Models of Disability
subtopics.description: Historical trajectory of disability awareness, models of disability, and understanding learner diversity.

concepts.name: Historical Evolution & Models of Disability
concepts.description: National and international historical shifts in treating disability; medical, charity, social, and human-rights models.
concepts.learning_objective: Compare various models of disability and trace the historical progression toward rights-based perspectives.

concepts.name: Addressing Diverse Learning Needs
concepts.description: Understanding individual differences, types of diversity in classroom settings, and addressing special needs.
concepts.learning_objective: Recognize classroom diversity and plan instructional responses for heterogeneous student populations.

subtopics.name: Paradigms and Principles of Inclusive Education
subtopics.description: Transition from segregation to inclusion, barriers to inclusion, Universal Design for Learning (UDL), and differentiation.

concepts.name: Segregation, Integration, and Inclusion
concepts.description: Conceptual contrast between segregation, integrated education, and true social and academic inclusion.
concepts.learning_objective: Differentiate between segregation, integration, and inclusion in special education history and practice.

concepts.name: Principles and Barriers of Inclusive Education
concepts.description: Core principles underlying inclusive schools and systemic, attitudinal, and environmental barriers to inclusion.
concepts.learning_objective: Identify key barriers to inclusive education and formulate strategies to mitigate them.

concepts.name: Universal Design for Learning (UDL)
concepts.description: Principles of UDL: multiple means of engagement, representation, and action/expression.
concepts.learning_objective: Apply UDL principles to design learning environments accessible to all students.

concepts.name: Differentiated Teaching and Co-Teaching Methods
concepts.description: Strategies for differentiated instruction and collaborative co-teaching models between regular and special educators.
concepts.learning_objective: Select appropriate co-teaching strategies and differentiation methods for inclusive classrooms.

concepts.name: Stakeholders, Community, and Resource Mobilization
concepts.description: Roles of parents, school staff, local community, and resource mobilization in sustaining inclusive educational ecosystems.
concepts.learning_objective: Explain the responsibilities of community stakeholders and techniques for resource mobilization in inclusive setups.

topics.name: Educational Foundations in India - Policies & Frameworks
topics.description: Constitutional provisions, educational commissions, national policies, frameworks, and legal acts facilitating inclusion.

subtopics.name: Constitutional Provisions and Early Commissions
subtopics.description: Indian Constitution, Fundamental Rights, Article 21A, and landmark early educational commissions.

concepts.name: Constitutional Provisions for Education
concepts.description: Directive Principles, Fundamental Rights and Duties, equality of opportunity, and Article 21A (RTE 2002).
concepts.learning_objective: Analyze the constitutional safeguards, Fundamental Rights, and Article 21A ensuring access to education.

concepts.name: Educational Commissions (1948-1966)
concepts.description: Key recommendations of University Education Commission (1948-49), Secondary Education Commission (1952-53), and Kothari Commission (1964-66).
concepts.learning_objective: Summarize major findings and recommendations of early Indian education commissions regarding equal opportunities.

subtopics.name: Policies, Schemes, and Curriculum Frameworks
subtopics.description: National policies, educational schemes (SSA, RMSA, IEDSS), and national curriculum frameworks.

concepts.name: Educational Schemes for Inclusion (IEDC, DPEP, SSA, RMSA, IEDSS)
concepts.description: Objectives and implementations of IEDC (1974), PIED, DPEP, Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA), RMSA, and IEDSS.
concepts.learning_objective: Trace the development of inclusive education schemes in India and their impact on access.

concepts.name: National Education Policies (NEP 1986, POA 1992, NEP 2020)
concepts.description: Disability and inclusion highlights in NEP 1986, Plan of Action 1992, and NEP 2020.
concepts.learning_objective: Compare the focus on special and inclusive education across NEP 1986, POA 1992, and NEP 2020.

concepts.name: Curriculum Frameworks (NCF 2005, NCFFS 2022, NCFSE 2023)
concepts.description: Inclusive guidelines in NCF 2005, NCF for Foundational Stage (2022), and NCF for School Education (2023).
concepts.learning_objective: Identify inclusive pedagogical guidelines outlined in NCF 2005, NCFFS 2022, and NCFSE 2023.

subtopics.name: Disability Rights, Acts, and Equality of Opportunity
subtopics.description: Legislative acts protecting disability rights and ensuring equal opportunity across all educational levels.

concepts.name: Disability Legislation: PWD Act 1995 & RPWD Act 2016
concepts.description: Provisions, benchmark disability definitions, rights, and educational guarantees under PWD Act 1995 and RPWD Act 2016.
concepts.learning_objective: Compare PWD Act 1995 and RPWD Act 2016, highlighting expanded disability categories and legal mandates.

concepts.name: RTE Act 2009, RCI Act 1992, and National Trust Act 1999
concepts.description: Key rights under RTE Act 2009, role of Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI Act 1992), and National Trust Act 1999.
concepts.learning_objective: Explain the mandates of RTE Act 2009, regulatory role of RCI, and provisions of the National Trust Act 1999.

concepts.name: National Policy for Persons with Disabilities (2006)
concepts.description: Focus areas and principles of the National Policy for PwD 2006 for education, rehabilitation, and equal opportunity.
concepts.learning_objective: Outline the policy framework and goals of the National Policy for PwD 2006.

concepts.name: Ensuring Equality of Educational Opportunity
concepts.description: Strategies to promote equitable education across elementary, secondary, and higher education sectors.
concepts.learning_objective: Formulate measures to ensure equal educational access across elementary, secondary, and tertiary education levels.

topics.name: Inclusive Education - Academic Instructions and Practice
topics.description: Instructional strategies, adaptations, early intervention, teacher training, and departmental collaboration.

subtopics.name: Curricular Adaptations and Instructional Support
subtopics.description: Adaptations, accommodations, modifications, early intervention, and foundational literacy in inclusive settings.

concepts.name: Curricular Adaptations, Accommodations & Modifications
concepts.description: Definitions and practical execution of curricular adaptations, instructional accommodations, and content modifications.
concepts.learning_objective: Differentiate between adaptations, accommodations, and modifications and apply them to lesson planning.

concepts.name: Early Identification and Early Intervention
concepts.description: Importance, tools, and processes of early screening, identification, and developmental intervention.
concepts.learning_objective: Explain the significance and strategies of early identification and timely intervention for special needs children.

concepts.name: Foundational Literacy for Inclusive Education
concepts.description: Adapting foundational literacy and numeracy instruction to diverse special needs learners.
concepts.learning_objective: Design inclusive strategies for developing foundational literacy in children with special needs.

concepts.name: Gender and Disability: Women and Girl Child
concepts.description: Double marginalization, issues, and supportive interventions for women and girl children with disabilities.
concepts.learning_objective: Analyze the intersectional challenges faced by girls and women with disabilities and suggest inclusive policies.

subtopics.name: Collaborations, Teacher Preparation, and Support Systems
subtopics.description: Roles of special educators, general teachers, welfare departments, and professional training programs.

concepts.name: Special Educators and General Education Teachers
concepts.description: Collaborative relationships, role division, and team teaching between general and special education teachers.
concepts.learning_objective: Detail the complementary roles and collaborative methods between general class teachers and special educators.

concepts.name: Teacher Education Programs in Special Education
concepts.description: Structure, training, pre-service, and in-service professional development programs in special education.
concepts.learning_objective: Evaluate teacher training frameworks for special and inclusive education in India.

concepts.name: Inter-Departmental Collaboration and Social Welfare
concepts.description: Coordination between the Social Welfare Department, Department of Education, health services, and voluntary agencies.
concepts.learning_objective: Describe how multi-departmental convergence enhances resource delivery for inclusive education.
